focus: Practical software engineering, scientific research tools, and automation across sectors
title: A Small P-Value Is Not the Whole Result
utility_use_case: Before archiving a research asset tree or a production build directory, run the report to find byte-identical copies and estimate possible storage savings. Review the listed paths with application owners before changing anything. The utility is intentionally read-only and cannot determine whether duplicate paths are semantically interchangeable.

source.book_label: Math for Deep Learning - What You Need to Know to Understand

generation.estimate_note: Standard uncached token estimate; cache writes, discounts, and actual billing can differ.

editorial_review.summary: Corrected the Welch degrees of freedom and associated rounded values in the worked example, and corrected the README’s complexity claim to account for sorting and path storage.

edits.old: If there are $N$ eligible files and $B$ bytes across files that need hashing, traversal and bookkeeping are proportional to the number of paths, while hashing work is proportional to $B$.
edits.new: If there are $N$ eligible files and $B$ bytes across files that need hashing, the sorted traversal and bookkeeping require $O(N\log N)$ time and $O(N)$ path storage, while hashing work is proportional to $B$.
